## About
P & G Keene Electrical Rebuilders specializes in heavy duty and industrial applications. We carry new, aftermarket new and factory remanufactured starters, alternators, generators and DC motors, along with our own line of units rebuilt in house.
We're an authorized warehouse distributor and service center for all major starter and alternator brands, and a trained, certified and authorized factory remanufacturing center for C.E. Niehoff. We also run our own rewinding facility for armatures, rotors and coils.
Our Bensenville location is currently closed, so we're serving Bensenville customers from Bridgeview, including pickup and delivery. Customers rate us 4.9 from 57 reviews on Google.

## Services
- In house rebuilt and remanufactured units: Our own line of starters, alternators and more, rebuilt and remanufactured in our shop.
- New and factory remanufactured starters, alternators, generators and DC motors: A complete line to choose from for heavy duty and industrial work.
- Rewinding for armatures, rotors and coils: Rewinding work handled at our own facility.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on heavy duty and industrial equipment?
A: Yes. Heavy duty and industrial applications are our specialty.

Q: Is the Bensenville location open?
A: It's currently closed. We're handling service, pickup and delivery for Bensenville customers from our Bridgeview shop.

Q: Can you rebuild my starter?
A: Yes. Reviewers mention bringing in a starter and having it rebuilt.
